person: Lan Tran is a 41-year-old pharmacy technician. Her chain closed her store and her last day is Friday 2 October 2026. She lives with her two children and her mother, and she runs the family's papers on her phone. English is her second language, and she reads official letters slowly. Her hours were cut in the summer, so her income is lower this year. She has a back scan on 10 November and wants it covered. She is afraid of mistakes and of hidden fees, because an "application helper" once took her money for nothing.
stated_up_front: Hello. My store closed and my work gave me papers about money and insurance. I do not understand which to sign. Please help me, and tell me if anything costs money.

facts.truth: Option A pays 2,800.00 dollars on 20 October. Option B pays 2,800.00 dollars on 5 November. A third older paper makes her give up unemployment, and HR says it was cancelled.
10 November 2026, at a clinic near home. The new plan cannot start before 1 December.
1,340.00 dollars a month for the family. The paper says she has until 14 December to answer.
Lan, her son, and her daughter who starts college. Her mother has her own Medicare.
A Silver plan for the family. It would start 1 December if she chooses it in November.
A man called Mr. Hoang texted her. He says a Platinum plan must be bought today and costs much more each month.
